'''Jaspar Skeete''' was the [[City Governor]] of [[D'larah]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], appointed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from a candidate pool of the [[City/Legends|city]] residents. He was a personable man, but not skilled in crisis management, which made it difficult for him to keep the populace in line when it was announced that [[Demophon]]'s [[Demophon (star)|sun]] was going [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. Rumor had it Skeete had a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on standby at all times to evacuate himself when the supernova alarms went off.<ref name="TC" />
